Use ESA funds to bring piano learning home
Education Savings Accounts (ESA) allow families to customize their child’s learning journey and make the most of their education funds.
Now that Simply Piano is available to eligible families through ESA programs in select states, you can use your state funds to bring a complete music curriculum into your home. Simply Piano offers a structured learning path, real-time feedback, and practice that fits around homeschooling, charter school, tutoring, or family routines.
Trusted by
Find your state’s ESA instructions
ESA rules are different in every state. Find your state below to see what to check before using ESA funds for Simply Piano. We are currently available in Texas, Louisiana, Utah, Wyoming, South Carolina, Arizona, Alabama, Arkansas, Missouri, New Hampshire, New York.
More states are coming soon, so stay tuned.
Is your state not available yet?
Leave your email and we'll let you know if an ESA payment option for Simply products becomes available in your state.

steps.title: Simply Piano
steps.text:
← Back to shop
Simply Piano
USD 169.90
Simply Piano is an award-winning interactive music education platform that teaches piano through structured, curriculum-based lessons. Students progress at their own pace through technique, music theory, sight-reading, and full songs, with real-time audio feedback that responds to every note they play.
Used by families as a core or supplemental music curriculum, Simply Piano covers a full range of skill levels from first-time players to intermediate students. The app is designed to replace or complement traditional music instruction, making it a recognized educational software tool for home learners.
Each subscription includes a digital access code delivered by email after purchase. Compatible with any acoustic or digital piano or keyboard sold separately. App available on iOS and Android.
